articles.abstract_en: What are the effects of supply-side climate policies in the oil market? We use global company-level data to estimate the impact of 84 reforms of production taxes between 2000 and 2019 on oil production, exploration, and discoveries. We find that higher taxes primarily reduce companies’ exploration expenditures and oil discoveries, and also reduce short-term production of unconventional oil. We then quantify the implications for the oil market using a short- and medium-term dynamic model extending until the end of the century. Imposing a global climate royalty surcharge of 20 percentage points on oil producers reduces average annual emissions from oil by 5–7% in the first 5 years, and 9–20% in the medium term. If only OECD countries adopt this policy, 47–73% of the total emission reductions would be offset by increased production in non-OECD countries in the medium term.
articles.abstract_cn: 供应方气候政策对石油市场有何影响？我们使用全球公司层面的数据来估计2000和2019之间84生产税改革对石油生产、勘探和发现的影响。我们发现，较高的税收主要减少了公司的勘探支出和石油发现，同时也减少了非常规石油的短期产量。然后，我们使用持续到本世纪末的短期和中期动态模型来量化对石油市场的影响。对石油生产商征收 20%的全球气候特许权附加费，可在前 5 年将石油年平均排放量减少 5-7%，在中期减少 9-20%。如果只有经合组织国家采取这一政策，中期减排总量的47-73%将被非经合组织国家产量的增加所抵消。

articles.abstract_en: We study narratives about the macroeconomy—the stories people tell to explain macroeconomic phenomena—in the context of a historic surge in inflation. In our empirical analysis, we field surveys with more than 10,000 U.S. households and 100 academic experts, measure economic narratives in open-ended questions, and represent them as directed acyclic graphs. Households’ narratives are strongly heterogeneous, coarser than experts’ narratives, focus more on the supply than the demand side, and often feature politically charged explanations. Moreover, narratives shape how households form inflation expectations and interpret new information, which we demonstrate in a series of experiments. Informed by these findings, our theoretical analysis incorporates narratives into an otherwise conventional New Keynesian model and demonstrates their importance for aggregate outcomes through their effect on agents’ expectations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究关于宏观经济的叙事——人们用来解释宏观经济现象的故事——在通胀历史性飙升的背景下。在我们的实证分析中，我们对超过10,000美国家庭和100学术专家进行了实地调查，在开放式问题中测量经济叙事，并将其表示为有向无环图。家庭的叙事高度异质，比专家的叙事更粗糙，更关注供给侧而非需求侧，并且常常带有政治色彩的解释。此外，叙事塑造了家庭形成通胀预期和解读新信息的方式，我们在一系列实验中对此进行了证明。基于这些发现，我们的理论分析将叙事纳入一个原本常规的新凯恩斯模型中，并通过叙事对主体预期的影响证明了它们对总体结果的重要性。

articles.title_en: Inference Based on Time-Varying SVARs Identified with Sign Restrictions
articles.title_cn: 基于符号约束识别的时变SVAR的推断
articles.abstract_en: We propose an approach for Bayesian inference in time-varying structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) identified with sign restrictions. The linchpin of our approach is a class of rotation-invariant time-varying SVARs in which the prior and posterior densities of any sequence of structural parameters belonging to the class are invariant to orthogonal transformations of the sequence. Our methodology is new to the literature. In contrast to existing algorithms for inference based on sign restrictions, our algorithm is the first to draw from a uniform distribution over the sequences of orthogonal matrices given the reduced-form parameters. We illustrate our procedure for inference by analyzing the role played by monetary policy during the latest inflation surge.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在具有符号约束识别的时变结构向量自回归（SVAR）中进行贝叶斯推断的方法。我们方法的关键是一类旋转不变的时变SVAR，其中属于该类的任意结构参数序列的先验和后验密度对该序列的正交变换保持不变。我们的方法在文献中是新的。与基于符号约束进行推断的现有算法相比，我们的算法是第一个在给定简化式参数的条件下从正交矩阵序列上的均匀分布中抽取的算法。我们通过分析货币政策在最近一次通胀飙升期间所发挥的作用来说明我们的推断程序。

articles.title_en: Gendered Spheres of Learning and Household Decision-Making over Fertility
articles.title_cn: 性别化的学习领域与家庭生育决策
articles.abstract_en: While men and women make joint decisions about fertility, women give birth and are more likely to learn about a significant cost of childbearing—maternal health risk. Within couples in Zambia, men have systematically lower awareness of maternal risk factors and higher desire for children than their wives. We develop a model in which information asymmetries between partners over maternal health risk can persist in equilibrium due to strategic incentives and can generate disagreement over fertility that cannot be resolved with transfers. To study the effect of communication barriers on fertility, we design an experiment that varies whether the husband or the wife receives information about maternal health risk. One year after the intervention, men told about such risk exhibit significant gains in knowledge, report lower demand for children, and communicate this information to their wives, who also update their beliefs. Pregnancy falls significantly, while transfers remain unchanged relative to the control group. Meanwhile, when women are told about risk, they update their beliefs, but fail to transmit the information to their husbands, who do not change their demand for children. While pregnancy also falls among these couples, the decline is accompanied by a significant reduction in transfers and support to the wife. When childbearing costs, particularly those borne by one party, cannot be easily communicated within the household, targeting information can help overcome asymmetries and improve household decision-making.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管男性和女性共同做出生育决策，但女性承担生育，且更可能了解生育的一项重大成本——孕产妇健康风险。在赞比亚的夫妻中，男性对孕产妇风险因素的认知系统性地低于妻子，且生育意愿高于妻子。我们构建了一个模型，其中伴侣间关于孕产妇健康风险的信息不对称因策略性激励而在均衡中持续存在，并可能产生无法通过转移支付解决的生育分歧。为研究沟通障碍对生育的影响，我们设计了一项实验，变化由丈夫还是妻子接收关于孕产妇健康风险的信息。干预一年后，被告知此类风险的男性知识显著增加，报告较低的子女需求，并将此信息传达给妻子，妻子也更新其信念。怀孕显著下降，而转移支付相对于对照组保持不变。同时，当女性被告知风险时，她们更新信念，但未能将信息传递给丈夫，丈夫的子女需求未改变。尽管这些夫妻的怀孕也下降，但下降伴随着对妻子的转移支付和支持的显著减少。当生育成本，特别是由一方承担的成本，无法在家庭内轻易沟通时，针对性信息可以帮助克服不对称并改善家庭决策。

articles.abstract_en: While the USD dominates cross-border transactions today, a few other currencies are also used internationally. This paper shows that central bank policies that reduce the volatility of borrowing costs for foreign firms in domestic currency can trigger a jumpstart of the currency’s international status, because firms’ choices of the currency of their working capital complement their sales invoicing. Empirically, the creation of swap lines by the People’s Bank of China between 2009 and 2018 supports this theoretical claim. Signing a swap line with a country is associated with an increase in the probability that the country would use the RMB at all by 12%, and a four-fold increase in the value of the country’s RMB payments.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管美元当前主导跨境交易，但少数其他货币也在国际上使用。本文表明，降低外国企业以本币借款成本波动的央行政策可以触发该货币国际地位的启动，因为企业对营运资本货币的选择与其销售计价互补。在实证上，中国人民银行在2009至2018年间创建互换额度支持了这一理论主张。与一国签署互换额度与该国完全使用人民币的概率增加12%以及该国人民币支付价值增长四倍相关。

articles.title_en: Destabilizing Capital Flows amid Global Inflation
articles.title_cn: 全球通胀背景下的资本流动失稳
articles.abstract_en: Over the latest monetary policy tightening cycle, capital has been flowing from low-inflation countries to high-inflation countries. This pattern of capital flows is consistent with the predictions of an open-economy model with nominal rigidities where cost-push shocks generate an inflationary episode and capital flows freely across countries. Yet, by raising demand for domestic non-tradable goods and services, capital inflows cause unwelcome upward pressure on firms’ costs in countries most severely hit by these shocks. We find that a reverse pattern of capital flows would have improved the output-inflation trade-off globally, hence requiring a less aggressive monetary tightening in the most severely hit countries and delivering overall welfare gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 在最近一轮货币政策紧缩周期中，资本从低通胀国家流向高通胀国家。这种资本流动模式与一个具有名义刚性的开放经济模型的预测一致，在该模型中，成本推动冲击引发通胀，且资本在国家间自由流动。然而，资本流入通过提高对国内非贸易品和服务的需求，对受这些冲击最严重国家的企业成本造成了不受欢迎的上行压力。我们发现，反向的资本流动模式本可改善全球的产出-通胀权衡，从而使受冲击最严重的国家需要更不激进的货币紧缩，并带来整体福利收益。

articles.title_en: Investing in Influence: Investors, Portfolio Firms, and Political Giving
articles.title_cn: 投资于影响力：投资者、投资组合公司与政治捐款
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the rise of institutional ownership has influenced firms’ political activities. We find that, after the acquisition of a large stake, a firm’s political action committee giving mirrors more closely that of the acquiring investor. Consistent with a causal interpretation, this pattern is also observed for acquisitions driven by new index inclusions. The pattern is stronger when firms’ management faces contentious proposals in shareholder meetings and may thus need institutional investors’ support. We further show that firms’ giving shifts away from business-relevant politicians and is strongly aligned with the individual campaign donations of the institutional investors’ employees. These results, together with the finding that the effects are larger for more “partisan” and privately owned investors, suggest that the influence we uncover is driven by institutional investors’ own political views, rather than a profit-maximizing strategy for the portfolio firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察机构持股的兴起如何影响公司的政治活动。我们发现，在收购大量股份后，公司的政治行动委员会捐款与收购投资者的捐款更为接近。与因果解释一致，这一模式在由新指数纳入驱动的收购中也能观察到。当公司管理层在股东大会上面临有争议的提案、因而可能需要机构投资者支持时，这一模式更强。我们进一步表明，公司的捐款偏离与业务相关的政客，并与机构投资者员工的个人竞选捐款高度一致。这些结果，连同效应对于更“党派化”和私人持有的投资者更大的发现，表明我们所揭示的影响是由机构投资者自身的政治观点驱动的，而不是为投资组合公司利润最大化的策略。

articles.title_en: Do The Effects of Nudges Persist? Theory and Evidence from 38 Natural Field Experiments
articles.title_cn: 助推的效果会持续吗？来自38项自然田野实验的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We formalize a research design to uncover the mechanisms underlying long-term reductions in energy consumption caused by a widely implemented nudge. We consider two channels: technology adoption and habit formation. Using data from 38 natural field experiments, we isolate the role of technology adoption by comparing treatment and control homes after the initial resident moves, which discontinues the treatment for a home. We find that fully half of energy reductions persist in the home after treatment ends and show this persistence is consonant with a technology adoption channel. The role of technology in creating persistent behaviour change has important implications for designing behavioural interventions and evaluating their long-term social impacts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们形式化了一个研究设计，以揭示一项广泛实施的助推所导致的能源消耗长期下降背后的机制。我们考虑两个渠道：技术采用和习惯形成。利用来自38项自然田野实验的数据，我们通过比较初始住户搬出后（此时该住宅的处理被终止）的处理组和对照组住宅，分离出技术采用的作用。我们发现，足足一半的能源节约在住宅处理结束后仍然持续，并表明这种持续性与技术采用渠道相一致。技术在创造持久行为改变方面的作用，对设计行为干预和评估其长期社会影响具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: De Gustibus and Disputes about Reference Dependence
articles.title_cn: 论趣味与关于参照依赖的争论
articles.abstract_en: Existing tests of reference-dependent preferences assume universal loss aversion. This paper examines the implications of heterogeneity in gain-loss attitudes for such tests. In experiments on labour supply and exchange behaviour, we first measure gain-loss attitudes and then study a canonical treatment effect that distinguishes different models of reference dependence. We document substantial heterogeneity in gain-loss attitudes and evidence against universal loss aversion. Moreover, we find heterogeneous treatment effects over gain-loss attitudes consistent with formulations of expectations-based reference points. Assuming homogeneous preferences would lead to different and potentially incorrect conclusions in these tests. Our findings provide foundational support for reference points derived from expectations and help reconcile inconsistencies in prior empirical exercises.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有的参照依赖偏好检验假设普遍存在损失厌恶。本文考察得失态度异质性对此类检验的含义。在关于劳动供给和交换行为的实验中，我们首先测量得失态度，然后研究一个区分不同参照依赖模型的经典处理效应。我们记录了得失态度的显著异质性，并发现反对普遍损失厌恶的证据。此外，我们发现得失态度上的异质性处理效应与基于预期的参照点表述相一致。假设同质偏好会导致这些检验得出不同且可能错误的结论。我们的发现为源自预期的参照点提供了基础性支持，并有助于调和先前实证研究中的不一致之处。

articles.title_en: Optimal Decision Rules When Payoffs are Partially Identified
articles.title_cn: 当收益被部分识别时的最优决策规则
articles.abstract_en: We derive asymptotically optimal statistical decision rules for discrete choice problems when payoffs depend on a partially-identified parameter θ and the decision maker can use a point-identified parameter μ to deduce restrictions on θ. Examples include treatment choice under partial identification and pricing with rich unobserved heterogeneity. Our notion of optimality combines a minimax approach to handle the ambiguity from partial identification of θ given μ with an average risk minimization approach for μ. We show how to implement optimal decision rules using the bootstrap and (quasi-)Bayesian methods in both parametric and semiparametric settings. We provide detailed applications to treatment choice and optimal pricing. Our asymptotic approach is well suited for realistic empirical settings in which the derivation of finite-sample optimal rules is intractable.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们推导了离散选择问题中渐近最优的统计决策规则，其中收益依赖于部分识别的参数θ，且决策者可以利用点识别的参数μ来推断对θ的限制。例子包括部分识别下的处理选择和具有丰富未观测异质性的定价。我们的最优性概念将对在给定μ下θ的部分识别所产生模糊性的极小极大方法与对μ的平均风险最小化方法相结合。我们展示了如何在参数和半参数设定下使用自助法和（准）贝叶斯方法实施最优决策规则。我们提供了对处理选择和最优定价的详细应用。我们的渐近方法非常适合现实的经验设定，在这些设定中有限样本最优规则的推导是难以处理的。

articles.title_en: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
articles.title_cn: 解析空间经济中的总福利
articles.abstract_en: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总福利？在一类一般的空间均衡模型中，我们提供了一个总福利变化的公式，将其分解为与以下各项相关的项：(i) 技术 [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511-518]，(ii) 边际效用的空间分散，(iii) 财政外部性，(iv) 技术外部性，以及 (v) 再分配。我们进一步利用这一分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并表明，只要最优转移支付到位，仅技术项就能捕捉技术冲击的总福利效应。我们应用我们的框架来研究改善美国高速公路网络的福利收益。我们发现，在解释偏离 Fogel-Hulten 基准以评估福利收益时，边际效用的空间分散变化与技术外部性同样重要。

articles.abstract_en: Studies have shown that the standard law of belief updating—Bayes’ rule—is descriptively invalid in various settings. In this paper, I introduce and analyse a generalization of Bayes’ rule—Coarse Bayesian updating—accommodating much of the empirical evidence. I characterize the model axiomatically, show how it generates several well-known biases, and derive its main implications in static and dynamic settings. Each axiom expresses a property of Bayes’ rule but, conditional on the others, stops just short of making the agent fully Bayesian. The model employs standard primitives, making it suitable for applications; I demonstrate this by applying it to a standard setting of decision under risk, leading to a close relationship with the Blackwell information ordering and comparative measures of cognitive sophistication and bias.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究表明，标准的信念更新法则——贝叶斯法则——在各种情境下描述性无效。本文引入并分析贝叶斯法则的一个推广——粗贝叶斯更新——以容纳大量经验证据。我以公理化方式刻画该模型，展示其如何生成若干众所周知的偏差，并推导其在静态和动态环境中的主要含义。每条公理表达贝叶斯法则的一个性质，但在其他公理条件下，仅差一步即可使主体成为完全贝叶斯主体。该模型采用标准原始要素，使其适用于应用；我通过将其应用于风险下决策的标准情境来证明这一点，从而与Blackwell信息排序以及认知复杂性和偏差的比较测度产生密切关系。

articles.title_en: Should Monetary Policy Care about Redistribution? Optimal Monetary and Fiscal Policy with Heterogeneous Agents
articles.title_cn: 货币政策应关注再分配吗？异质性代理人下的最优货币与财政政策
articles.abstract_en: We present a method to determine optimal monetary policy in heterogeneous-agent economies with nominal frictions and aggregate shocks, under various assumptions regarding fiscal policy. We analyze models with either sticky prices or sticky wages. In the sticky-price economy, when fiscal policy is optimally set, optimal monetary policy implements price stability. Inflation volatility remains low when fiscal policy follows empirically relevant rules. The inflation response is more pronounced when the Phillips curve is steep and profits are skewed toward highly productive agents. In the sticky-wage economy, optimal price inflation becomes significantly more volatile, while wage inflation remains small. Under both types of nominal rigidity, agents with lower productivity tend to benefit more from optimal monetary policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种方法，用于在具有名义摩擦和总体冲击的异质性代理人经济中，在各种财政政策假设下确定最优货币政策。我们分析了具有粘性价格或粘性工资的模型。在粘性价格经济中，当财政政策被最优设定时，最优货币政策实现价格稳定。当财政政策遵循经验相关的规则时，通胀波动仍然较低。当菲利普斯曲线陡峭且利润偏向高生产率代理人时，通胀反应更为明显。在粘性工资经济中，最优价格通胀变得显著更加波动，而工资通胀仍然较小。在两种名义刚性下，生产率较低的代理人往往从最优货币政策中受益更多。

articles.title_en: Dynamic Regulation with Firm Linkages: Evidence from Texas
articles.title_cn: 具有企业关联的动态监管：来自德克萨斯州的证据
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the efficiency of dynamic linked environmental regulation. Linked regulation allows inspectors who uncover violations at one plant to increase future enforcement at other plants that share a common owner. When compliance costs are correlated, regulators can then target scarce enforcement resources towards bad actors without inspecting everyone. We develop an empirical framework of dynamic moral hazard under linked regulation that allows for large portfolios of plants and for choices to be interdependent within the portfolio of plants and across time. Using the framework we evaluate a linked regulation scheme in Texas and find that linked regulation performs substantially better than both unlinked regulation and untargeted regulation. We test two alternative theoretical mechanisms that underpin the benefit—a “firm-wide moral hazard mechanism” and a “correlated targeting mechanism”—and find that a large share of the value of linked regulation is due to the former.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估动态关联环境监管的效率。关联监管允许在一家工厂发现违规的检查员加强对同一所有者拥有的其他工厂的未来执法。当合规成本相关时，监管者便可以将稀缺的执法资源瞄准不良行为者，而无需检查每一个人。我们构建了一个关联监管下动态道德风险的实证框架，该框架允许大型工厂组合，并允许工厂组合内部以及跨时间的选择相互依赖。利用该框架，我们评估了德克萨斯州的一项关联监管方案，发现关联监管的表现显著优于非关联监管和无目标监管。我们检验了支撑该收益的两种替代性理论机制——“企业范围的道德风险机制”和“相关瞄准机制”——并发现关联监管价值的很大一部分来自前者。

articles.title_en: Normal Approximation in Large Network Models
articles.title_cn: 大型网络模型中的正态近似
articles.abstract_en: We prove a central limit theorem for network formation models with strategic interactions and homophilous agents. Since data often consists of observations on a single large network, we consider an asymptotic framework in which the network size diverges. We argue that a modification of “stabilization” conditions from the literature on geometric graphs provides a useful high-level formulation of weak dependence which we utilize to establish an abstract central limit theorem. Using results in branching process theory, we derive interpretable primitive conditions for stabilization. The main conditions restrict the strength of strategic interactions and equilibrium selection mechanism. We discuss practical inference procedures justified by our results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为具有策略互动和同质性主体的网络形成模型证明了一个中心极限定理。由于数据通常由对单个大型网络的观测组成，我们考虑网络规模发散的渐近框架。我们论证，对几何图文献中的“稳定化”条件进行修改，提供了弱依赖的一种有用高层次表述，我们利用它来建立一个抽象中心极限定理。利用分支过程理论中的结果，我们推导出稳定化的可解释原始条件。主要条件限制了策略互动的强度和均衡选择机制。我们讨论了由我们的结果所证成的实用推断程序。

articles.title_en: Identification of Time-Inconsistent Models: The Case of Insecticide-Treated Nets
articles.title_cn: 时间不一致模型的识别：以驱虫蚊帐为例
articles.abstract_en: Time-inconsistency may play a central role in explaining inter-temporal behaviour, particularly among poor households. However, little is known about the distribution of time-inconsistent agents, and time-preference parameters are typically not identified in standard dynamic choice models. We formulate a dynamic discrete choice model in an unobservedly heterogeneous population of possibly time-inconsistent agents. We provide conditions under which all population type probabilities and preferences for both time-consistent and sophisticated agents are point-identified and sharp set-identification results for naïve and partially sophisticated agents. Estimating the model using data from a health intervention providing insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) in rural Odisha, India, we find that about two-thirds of our sample comprises time-inconsistent agents and that both sophisticated and naïve agents are considerably present-biased. Counterfactuals show that the under-investment in ITNs attributable to present-bias leads to substantial costs that are about four times the price of an ITN.
articles.abstract_cn: 时间不一致可能在解释跨期行为中发挥核心作用，尤其是在贫困家庭中。然而，关于时间不一致代理人的分布知之甚少，且时间偏好参数在标准动态选择模型中通常不被识别。我们在一个可能具有时间不一致性的不可观测异质性代理人群体中构建了动态离散选择模型。我们提供了条件，在这些条件下，时间一致代理人和成熟型代理人的所有总体类型概率和偏好均被点识别，并给出了幼稚型和部分成熟型代理人的尖锐集合识别结果。利用来自印度奥里萨邦农村地区提供驱虫蚊帐（ITNs）的健康干预数据估计该模型，我们发现约三分之二的样本由时间不一致代理人构成，且成熟型和幼稚型代理人均表现出相当大的现时偏误。反事实分析表明，归因于现时偏误的ITNs投资不足导致了可观的成本，约为一顶ITN价格的四倍。

articles.title_en: Decision Theory for Treatment Choice Problems with Partial Identification
articles.title_cn: 部分识别下处理选择问题的决策理论
articles.abstract_en: We apply classical statistical decision theory to a large class of treatment choice problems with partial identification. We show that, in a general class of problems with Gaussian likelihood, all decision rules are admissible; it is maximin-welfare optimal to ignore all data; and, for severe enough partial identification, there are infinitely many minimax-regret optimal decision rules, all of which sometimes randomize the policy recommendation. We uniquely characterize the minimax-regret optimal rule that least frequently randomizes, and show that, in some cases, it can outperform other minimax-regret optimal rules in terms of what we call profiled regret. We analyse the implications of our results in the aggregation of experimental estimates for policy adoption, extrapolation of Local Average Treatment Effects, and policy making in the presence of omitted variable bias.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将经典统计决策理论应用于一大类具有部分识别的处理选择问题。我们证明，在具有高斯似然的一般类问题中，所有决策规则都是可容许的；忽略所有数据是最大最小福利最优的；并且，对于足够严重的部分识别，存在无穷多个最小最大后悔最优决策规则，所有这些规则有时会随机化政策建议。我们唯一地刻画了随机化频率最低的最小最大后悔最优规则，并表明，在某些情况下，该规则在我们所称的剖面后悔方面可以优于其他最小最大后悔最优规则。我们分析了我们的结果在用于政策采纳的实验估计聚合、局部平均处理效应的外推以及存在遗漏变量偏差时的政策制定中的含义。

articles.title_cn: 组织变革与参照依赖偏好
articles.abstract_en: Reference-dependent preferences can explain several puzzling observations about organizational change. We introduce a dynamic model in which a firm bargains with loss-averse workers about organizational change and wages. We show that change is often stagnant or slow for many periods, followed by a sudden boost in productivity triggered by a crisis. In a crisis, workers concede to organizational change but resist nominal wage reductions. In addition, the model explains why different firms in the same industry often have significant productivity differences. Finally, the model demonstrates the importance of expectations management even if all parties have rational expectations.
articles.abstract_cn: 参照依赖偏好可以解释关于组织变革的若干令人困惑的观察。我们引入一个动态模型，其中企业与损失厌恶的工人就组织变革和工资进行讨价还价。我们表明，变革往往在许多时期内停滞或缓慢，随后由危机触发生产率突然提升。在危机中，工人让步于组织变革，但抵制名义工资削减。此外，该模型解释了为什么同一行业中的不同企业往往具有显著的生产率差异。最后，该模型证明了预期管理的重要性，即使所有各方都具有理性预期。
